Name: Advanced_Copper_Tools
Author: Jared
Description: Adds copper-and-bronze metalworking content built from the metal sheets, nails and tin solder that CSFFModFramework ships (needs CSFFModFramework 2.28.9 or later; one sheet card and one nail card in every metal, iron included), a small copper stove and a copper brazier that warm, dry and light the camp like any fire (a recruited Partner NPC can be given the vanilla Fire keeping duty on them and on the metal lantern, but does not refuel the brazier or lantern while they are lit), wearable metal pan (multi-metal, weightless when worn) that can also pan river gravel for tin ore, large copper and iron saws with bonus tree-cutting while sharp, a metal wheelbarrow built on the wooden one with weight reduction, copper bathtub (3 states, with a Hot Bath tier for keeping the fire stoked, and a Wash with Soap interaction on the warm tub: a quick wash at any heat, so the fire need not be stoked), 4-variant metal lantern (also in iron, with an Iron Lantern Oilwell), which with the brazier and the copper oil flask takes any lamp oil in a clay bowl (ACT's rendered oil from animal fat or fatty fish meat, or with H&F installed its own oils) or poured from a container of liquid oil such as melted fat, copper oil flask, copper tea kettle, copper cauldron for batch cooking and brewing, sealed copper chest, a Tinned Storage Pot (a tin-lined clay pot that slows spoilage), a high-capacity open-topped Ore Bin for mined ore (greenstone, bog iron, tin ore, flint), a 3-variant Tea Blending Station with six herb slots, passive drying, a Grind All action, a built-in heated water reservoir, and three brewable herbal teas (Calming, Warming, Focus). Includes metal armor in six metals (copper, tin, ghost bronze, tin bronze, white bronze and iron): one recipe each for a helmet, bracers, greaves, torso armor and a hand-held shield, and the piece takes the metal of the sheets it is made from (ghost bronze wards against spiritual attacks and eases fear, white bronze bolsters courage, iron Armor refits between a man's and a woman's cut); all of it is furnace-recyclable into its own metal, and armor from older versions turns into the new cards by itself. Iron gear rusts while you are wet unless you give it an Oil Coat of Fat or Oil. The oil flask, cauldron, large saw and small stove track the metal they were built from (copper through white bronze), sheets and nails every metal from copper to iron, and the saw and stove work differently by metal. Also adds a copper watering can, a copper-rim chamberpot, and Salt-Cured Meat and Salt-Cured Fish, slow-spoiling rations made from raw meat or lean fish and salt, and a Bedwarming Pan (fill it with embers at a fire and tuck it into your bed to sleep warmer). A Copper-Buckled Tool Belt on its own waist slot carries six hand tools (hammers, knives, chisels, sickles, spoon augers, fire strikers, the whetstone and needles); a Cautery Iron heated in a fire closes an open cut at the cost of a burn; a Copper Spigot fitted to a sap or resin tap makes it run about three times as long, and a Copper Sap Bucket hung in the tap catches its sap or gathers its resin; a carried Grappling Hook makes every climb more likely to succeed; and, with Sirus23 Mod Collection installed, Copper Shears shear its tame sheep before you have iron.
